definition: Civitai is an online platform and marketplace for generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) content, primarily focused on AI-generated images and models, and AI-generated videos.
details: Civitai is an online platform and marketplace for generative artificial intelligence (Gen AI) content, primarily focused on AI-generated images and models, and AI-generated videos.

explainer.lead: Civitai is an online marketplace where people can find and share generative-AI models, images, and videos. It matters because it brings media and the models used to create it together in one place.

tiers.eli5: Civitai is like an online craft fair for computer-made pictures, videos, and the tools used to make them. You can look through what others have shared and find a tool for your own creative project.
tiers.practitioner: Use Civitai as a discovery and distribution point for generative-AI models and example media, not as a model architecture or training algorithm. Before adopting a model, check that it fits your workflow and verify its usage terms and output suitability. A marketplace listing alone does not establish quality or permission for every application.
tiers.paperLevel: Civitai can be described as a marketplace M over generative-AI assets A, where A includes models, generated images, and generated videos. Its role is asset distribution and discovery rather than model training or evaluation. The marketplace description alone provides no guarantee about model quality, provenance, or licensing.

explainer.example: A hobbyist wants to generate fantasy landscapes. They browse Civitai, compare available image-generation models and generated pictures, then obtain a suitable model to use in their own image-generation workflow.

usedIn.name: AI image generation
usedIn.detail: Finding models and sharing or browsing generated images.

usedIn.name: Generative-AI model distribution
usedIn.detail: Providing an online marketplace for models used to create media.

explainer.intuition: Civitai connects people who have generative-AI models or media with people looking for them. Think of it as a shared marketplace for both creative outputs and the models behind them.
howItWorks: Contributors share generative-AI models, images, or videos on the platform.
Civitai makes those items available through its online marketplace.
Users browse the available models and generated media.
A user can obtain a suitable model for a separate image- or video-generation workflow.
explainer.whyItMatters: Civitai provides a common place to discover and distribute generative-AI models alongside the images and videos they produce. This can make creative resources easier to find without treating the platform itself as the generator.
misconceptions: Civitai is not itself a generative model; it is a platform and marketplace.
Its content is not limited to still images: it also covers models and AI-generated videos.
A marketplace listing is not, by itself, proof of quality or permission for every use.

diagram.caption: Contributors supply models and generated media, which Civitai makes available to users through its marketplace.
